Hi Samir — no problem, thanks for the note. Glad Alicia’s on the thread. We can absolutely reschedule. Quick options (all PT):

- Thu Sep 23, 10:00–10:30
- Thu Sep 23, 14:30–15:00
- Mon Sep 27, 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, share a couple slots and we’ll match. I’ve re-attached the 1-page preflight; below are two quick checks you can try ahead of time to speed troubleshooting:

1) Verify API key and scopes (curl):
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/check\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"test": true}'

Expected response: 200 with JSON status and list of scopes. If you get 401/403, let us know the exact error body (please paste).

2) Node SDK quick install + test:
// install
npm install --save @redwood/inference

// quick test
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
(async () => {
  const r = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-small', prompt: 'hello' });
  console.log(r);
})();

Dev (copied) will join the call to help with proxy/CORS issues if that’s where the 403s are coming from. If you can paste the exact 403 body ahead of time, we’ll prepare diagnostics so the session is focused.

I’ve also added the slot options to my calendar; once you reply with the preferred slot I’ll send an updated invite and include a short runbook.

Regards,
Mina
